falsifiers.reasonDirectEffect: Cloudflare Fetch/Browser is a current production interaction that has neither Source World egress/issuance/departure nor Destination World materialization semantics
falsifiers.reasonGeneric: the common durability mechanics are already shared privately; preserving the remaining semantic laws would require a tagged/opaque wrapper that dispatches back to the typed families
falsifiers.reasonResourceVsMessage: accepted Game owner semantics are opposite on source-occurrence reuse: Resource occurrence is single-transfer while Message Fact can fan out to multiple message identities

laws: Shared interaction mechanics != shared interaction semantics.
Typed semantic families may share private durability machinery without becoming one public protocol.
Source consumption/fan-out semantics belong to the source owner.
Destination consequence meaning belongs to the destination/provider owner.
Receipt meaning is family-specific and historical; current state must be re-observed from its owner.
Direct external effect and cross-World transfer are distinct interaction families that share a lower causal/reconciliation skeleton.
limitations: D0 does not claim these four families exhaust all future interaction forms.
The Security Entity unit suite proves current destination contract behavior but does not repeat the earlier full physical KVM production acceptance.
D0 is classification research; it does not add an Agent-facing World interaction catalog.

productDecision.reason: production code already centralizes proven mechanical invariants while typed public contracts preserve materially different source and destination semantics

directExternalEffect.destinationConsequence: provider-native operation and receipt/artifact observed through World
directExternalEffect.sourceSemantics: Host Dispatch/Effect plus current capability condition; no Source World transfer occurrence required
directExternalEffect.terminalMeaning: provider effect/observation committed or remains UNKNOWN; not a cross-World materialization

entity.sourceSemantics: source-owned departure binds exact Entity and one migration while continuity remains opaque
entity.terminalMeaning: historical body materialization committed; not current Presence or cognition activation

message.destinationConsequence: informational admission only; knowledgePromoted=false and worldTruthPromoted=false
message.sourceSemantics: one retained visible source Fact may authorize multiple independently identified Messages
message.terminalMeaning: delivery committed; no custody transfer and no belief/world-truth promotion

resource.destinationConsequence: destination-owned object materialization in Security SampleVault plus transfer-specific admission
resource.sourceSemantics: one source resource occurrence may authorize only one transfer/destination under the accepted Game custody model
resource.terminalMeaning: historical materialization committed; not current resource Presence

roles: not-committed exact-original retry proof where supported
